title: Experience FLIBS 2025 with FYI Yachts
description: Join FYI Yachts at the 2025 Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show (FLIBS) Oct 29–Nov 2 for VIP access to 1,300+ vessels, luxury yachts, and industry premieres.
html:
Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show 2025 | October 29 – November 2

Every fall, the world of yachting converges in Fort Lauderdale for the largest in-water boat show on earth — and FYI Yachts will be there to help you experience it at its best.

From October 29 to November 2, join us for five unforgettable days at the 2025 Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show (FLIBS) — a celebration of innovation, craftsmanship, and the ultimate in marine luxury.

Your Insider Access to the World’s Premier Yacht Show

While many come to showcase their vessels, FYI Yachts comes to serve as your personal concierge and industry connection throughout the show. Our team will be on site to help you navigate every exhibit, schedule private tours, and connect directly with the builders, designers, and brokers shaping the future of yachting.

Whether you’re exploring cutting-edge new builds, scouting brokerage opportunities, or simply soaking in the atmosphere, FYI ensures your FLIBS experience is seamless and unforgettable.

About FLIBS 2025

Spanning seven iconic locations across Fort Lauderdale — from Bahia Mar Yachting Center and Las Olas Marina to the Superyacht Village at Pier Sixty-Six — FLIBS 2025 will feature over 1,300 vessels and 1,000+ exhibitors from around the world.

As the crown jewel of the international yachting calendar, the show attracts industry leaders, enthusiasts, and innovators for five days of world premieres, networking, and luxury lifestyle showcases.

Request A Private Tour

Thinking about buying or selling a yacht? The FYI Yachts team of yachting experts will be on hand to personally tour you aboard any boat at the show.

Simply complete our short form — including your contact details and future boating plans — and our team will arrange your exclusive VIP tour to the show.
